evidence: New Resume creates Untitled Resume with blank contact fields, empty summary (0/500), empty experience/education lists, and empty skills list; all inputs editable immediately.
Start/end date inputs are type=month (consistent MM/YYYY format). Checking 'I currently work here' cleared end-date value and disabled the end-date input.

issue: Invalid date periods are not rejected or flagged
actual: Setting an experience end date (2019-01) before its start date (2020-01) produced no validation error, no aria-invalid, no styling change, and no message anywhere on the page. Setting a start date in the future (2027-01) likewise produced no feedback. Values were silently accepted.

evidence: Edited contact fields and summary text; added two experience entries, edited fields, reordered via move-up (Beta Inc moved above Acme Corp); added an education entry with full fields; added two skills, changed a skill's level (Node.js Intermediate->Expert), added and removed a temporary skill successfully.

Selecting Modern, Classic, and Minimal template options each updated the preview's visual formatting (heading case, separators) while contact, summary, experience, education, and skills content remained intact across all three switches.

issue: Customized section heading not rendered in one style
actual: Renamed Summary heading to 'Career Summary' (and other headings similarly). Modern and Classic templates correctly render 'Career Summary' as the Summary section heading, but the Minimal template renders the Summary text without any heading at all (no preview.summary.heading element present), even though the section is visible and has content.

evidence: Moved Education section above Experience via move-up control, and toggled Skills section visibility off. Preview immediately reflected new order (Education before Experience) and omitted the Skills section and heading entirely.
Renamed resume title to 'Software Engineer Resume v2' via editor.title; the same title is shown in the editor's title control and on the dashboard card (key fe7xad4wkkh) after navigating back.
After switching editor tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume, contact details, summary, experience entries, education entry, and (hidden) skills all remained exactly as entered.

Reordering sections (Education moved above Experience) and hiding Skills updated the preview immediately; after navigating to dashboard and reopening the resume within the session, the new order and hidden Skills section persisted.
Edited fields across tabs, renamed title, returned to dashboard (card showed updated title and 'Updated Aug 25, 2026'), then reopened the resume and all edits were retained.
Typing into contact fields, summary, experience/education fields, and switching templates all reflected instantly in the preview pane without any explicit save or page refresh.
Clicking 'Hide Preview' removed the preview region while editor fields/tabs remained intact; clicking 'Show Preview' restored the preview with all content and Modern template correctly re-rendered.

With 6 experience entries plus long descriptions added, page/preview grew to a scrollHeight of ~2900px (viewport 720px); all visible sections with content (contact, summary, experience, education) rendered in the DOM, and scrollIntoView on the last experience entry confirmed it becomes visible, i.e. the full resume remains reachable via scrolling.

issue: No validation feedback on empty/whitespace rename
actual: Attempting to rename the resume to a whitespace-only string or an empty string is rejected — the title reverts to 'Software Engineer Resume v2' — but no error message, toast, inline text, or any other validation feedback is shown to the user anywhere on the page.

evidence: Duplicated 'Software Engineer Resume v2' via the card menu, renamed the copy to 'Product Manager Application Resume' via the rename dialog, edited the copy's full name to 'Jane Doe-Copy', and confirmed the original resume's contact name remained 'Jane Doe' unchanged.

After duplication, editing the copy's full name to 'Jane Doe-Copy' did not affect the original (still 'Jane Doe'); editing the original's phone to '999-999-9999' did not affect the copy (still '555-123-4567').

Dashboard now lists multiple distinct resume variations created during this session (Software Engineer Resume v2, Product Manager Application Resume, plus pre-existing sample resumes), each independently editable.

Searching 'product' (lowercase) matched 'Product Manager Application Resume' and 'Product Designer Resume' case-insensitively; clearing the search restored all 5 resumes. Sorting 'Oldest First' ordered resumes from Jan 2024 to Aug 2026 (creation order, oldest duplicate source before its copy); 'Newest First' reversed the order correctly.

actual: The dashboard only offers a title search box and a sort dropdown (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Z-A). There is no UI control, hidden or visible, to filter resumes by an exact creation date or a date range; a full-page text/DOM scan found no date-filter inputs anywhere on the dashboard.

After creating 'Software Engineer Resume v2', editing its content, duplicating it, and renaming the copy to 'Product Manager Application Resume', reloading the app (navigating to http://localhost:6005/) reset the dashboard to only the 3 original seed resumes (Software Engineer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Product Designer Resume). Both localStorage and sessionStorage are empty, confirming no persistence mechanism is used; all created/edited/duplicated/renamed resumes were lost on reload.
